proposal.hypothesis: One simdgroup per row with simd_sum avoids threadgroup barriers and partial-memory reduction; caching eight float4 values per lane in registers eliminates the second input read, improving bandwidth for 256x1024.
Using 256 threads per row with one float4 per thread increases parallelism and memory-level occupancy versus one SIMD per row, outweighing the threadgroup reduction cost for 256x1024.
128 threads per row loading two float4 each gives 4x parallelism over one SIMD per row, improving bandwidth utilization for 256x1024 while SIMD plus threadgroup reduction stays cheap.
